newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 2.7 higher vs dlr at 1,060.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 2.7 higher vs dlr at 1,060.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso moved up 2.7 pesos against the dollar to close at 1,060.00 on selling of U.S. currency by banks and the corporate sector, interbank dealers said.

They said the selling appeared to have been prompted by a high court's recent decision to overturn government economic emergency measures unveiled in January being formalized Friday with the ruling's publication in the official gazette.

The emergency measures included a 6.0 percent tax on all new foreign loans as part of the government's bid to stem the flood of foreign capital that drove the peso to artifically high trading levels late last year.
"In view of the imminent flood of dollars, many banks are rotating their positions and going short dollars," a trader said.
Dealers reported 272 trades for a total of $115 million and said the peso hit an intraday low of 1,062 before moving higher into the close.
